detail.longDescription: Woo! New # Immich release with upgraded face-recognition sharing getting very good reviews and feedback. If you've been looking to get your photos off "the cloud" and onto a private, open source service that you host yourself, then now is a really good time. Face sharing has been a bit of a roadblock for a lot of people (especially families), but not any more! https:// github.com/immich-app/immich/r eleases/tag/v3.3.0 # SelfHosted # Homelab # photography # DataSovereignty
